capabilities: search notes automatically from the current line or block while typing
index Obsidian notes and Anki notes via AnkiConnect
show results in a pane that can be reopened by command
toggle indexes and set debounce refresh timeouts in settings
disambiguation: Not a replacement for the core Search panel; it searches live for the line being typed and shows results in a side pane.
extras: Several README sections (external indexes, config, integrations, API) are marked TODO; the README contains a long roadmap of planned features. Anki setup requires adding app://obsidian.md to AnkiConnect's webCorsOriginList.
intentEvidence: inspired by siac section in readme
motivation: The author lists benefits: linking similar ideas while writing, preventing redundant notes, and easier maintenance by updating past notes on sight.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search requires manually opening the search UI, so you cannot see existing similar notes while writing a line.

relations.evidence: Install ankiconnect in anki if you haven't already
inspired by siac section in readme

summary: As-you-type search that finds matching Obsidian and Anki notes based on the current line you are writing.
